factory_inventory.method: Two independent scans of every tracked monorepo file against bicameral-factory at c7e682b (2,013 paths). Scan 1: Factory paths with a directory component in files that mention Factory. Scan 2: every Factory path and every distinctive Factory file basename in any file, Python imports and dynamic loads of Factory module names, paths used after any workflow checkout of the Factory repository, and FACTORY_* variables and --factory-* arguments. Each hit was reviewed against how its consumer uses it. Scan 2 found one dependency scan 1 missed (the operator-service topology profile); its other hits are identifier collisions (field and enum names), same-named root files (README.md, SECURITY.md, ...), references to excluded .qor/ records, attestation and repo-governance paths already excluded, and FACTORY_* variables of the excluded attestation scripts or provenance-only commit fields.
